Exactly EIGHT fully separate whole-body right-facing/three-quarter poses, 4 columns x 2 rows, generous transparent gutters, all ears/hands/toes fully inside canvas. Row-major: 1 ultimate wind-up low sprinter brace; 2 ultimate active forward speed punch/claw drive; 3 ultimate recover guard; 4 neutral upright relaxed athletic guard; 5 defensive crossed-arm guard; 6 UPRIGHT hit recoil with feet planted; 7 defeated lying sideways as one connected body; 8 low forward sprint dash with rear leg lifted and arms driving. BODY ONLY: no speed streaks, painted motion lines, glows, power balls, ghost copies, ground, shadows, dust, labels or text. True transparent background. Keep at least 25px margin around each FULL silhouette, do not clip extended fists or feet.
